graph_not_on_cv.why: The graph identifies a 1990 thesis, consistent with the CV's Yale Ph.D. year and the title of Cronon's 1991 book. The CV does not name the Yale dissertation. A thesis and its published book are distinct versions, so this is not demonstrably a duplicate.

doctorate.cv: Ph.D., Yale University, December 1990, American history; dissertation title and supervisor not stated. D.Phil., Oxford University, May 1981, British urban and economic history; unpublished dissertation Energy and the Growth of an English Town: Coventry 1860-1950; supervisor not stated.
doctorate.graph: w-10115, thesis, 1990, Nature's Metropolis: Chicago and the Great West; thesis_advisor: Lamar, Howard Roberts. The supplied graph gives no thesis institution and no Oxford doctorate/thesis.
doctorate.note: The 1990 thesis year agrees with the Yale Ph.D. year; agreement is limited to that comparison. The CV does not independently establish the graph's Yale dissertation title or advisor, and the graph omits the Oxford D.Phil. and its named dissertation. Howard Lamar's appearance as a co-supervisor of Cronon's students does not establish that he supervised Cronon.

notes: CV dated October 2024; comparison uses only the two supplied files. w-547 conflates an afterword title with the book's 1983 date: the CV dates the new afterword to 2003. Its matches to the book, anniversary edition and afterword refer to one compromised record. w-2399 also has a truncated citation title. Most CV publications and the Oxford doctorate are missing from the graph. Reprints/excerpts may share an original graph ID; unknown years are null. Weyerhaeuser books are represented by Cronon's forewords, preserving his contribution rather than assigning him the host authors' works; he also edited the series. Other Edited Books retain the named authors and Cronon's editorial role. Remembering Ahanagran's foreword is assigned to the 2004 reprint. Published interviews, Portney's account of talks, committee publications and collaborative/student-authored digital projects are included with qualified roles. The seven textbook essays are grouped because individual titles are absent. Unnamed reviews/films, unpublished teaching packets, the unpublished Oxford dissertation, works in progress, and presentations, grants, teaching and service without publications are excluded from cv_works. Students are matched across name order, case and middle-name variants; 'Nyala, Hannah' matches Hannah Nyala West. Spring Greeney appears twice in the graph: 37 entries represent 36 people, all on the CV, with 23 CV supervisees missing.
